# Site Assessment for Nature-based solutions

Author1, Author2, and Author3

<span style="color: red;">ALL CONTENT IN THIS REPORT IS PRELIMINARY AND DRAFT. DO NOT REFERENCE FOR ANY PURPOSE.</span>

Key topics:  

- Building context on socio-ecological-technical systems. What processes are ongoing?  
- Collecting data on ecological systems as well as infrastructure.  
- Identifying site constraints. Design constraints in terms of infrastructure. Ecological constraints of the site. Are there site conditions where a "do no harm" principle applies?  
- Harnessing and integrating multiple data streams (e.g., remote sensing, data compilation, in situ).  
- Evolution of site assessment as level of design increases.  
- Lead readers to defining what the site can accommodate on a gradient of natural to hardened solutions.
